تستوقفون (form X)
# تَسْتَوْقِفُونَ (tastawqifūna) /tas.taw.qi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْقَفَ (istawqafa)
# تُسْتَوْقَفُونَ (tustawqafūna) /tus.taw.qa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْقَفَ (istawqafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
